points: Her feet are beautiful with shoes, O prince's daughter, the joints of her thighs like jewels, her navel like a round goblet, and her belly like a heap of wheat set about with lilies.

note.label: Song of Solomon 7: The Beauty of the Beloved

points: Her two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, her neck a tower of ivory, her eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, and her nose as the tower of Lebanon looking toward Damascus.

note.label: Song of Solomon 7: The Beauty of the Beloved

points: Her head is like Carmel and her hair like purple, the king held in the galleries; he calls her fair and pleasant, her stature like a palm tree and her breasts like clusters of grapes.

note.label: Song of Solomon 7: The Beauty of the Beloved

points: He will go up to the palm tree and take hold of its boughs, and her breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, the smell of her nose like apples, and the roof of her mouth like the best wine that goes down sweetly.

note.label: Song of Solomon 7: The Beauty of the Beloved

points: She says, "I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me," and calls him to go forth into the field, to lodge in the villages, and to rise early to the vineyards to see whether the vine flourishes.

note.label: Song of Solomon 7: The Beauty of the Beloved

points: There she will give him her loves; the mandrakes give a smell, and at their gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, laid up for her beloved.
